title: Arrival in Tokachi & Obihiro Evening
description: Arrive in the Tokachi region and dive into Obihiro's legendary food scene.

activities.title: Pick Up Rental Car
activities.description: 25 minutes to central Obihiro through golden Tokachi farmland.
details: 📍 Tokachi-Obihiro Airport (OBO) — flights from Tokyo Haneda (1h45m)
🚗 Toyota Rent-a-Car and Times Car have airport counters

activities.title: Butadon at Pancho
activities.description: Obihiro's iconic dish since 1933 — thick pork loin, charcoal-grilled with sweet-savory tare sauce over hot rice.

activities.title: Hotel in Central Obihiro
activities.description: Stay near the station for easy restaurant access.
details: 🏨 Dormy Inn Obihiro (rooftop onsen + late-night soba) or Hotel Nikko Northland

title: Sweets, Farms & Tokachigawa Onsen
description: Tokachi's famous sweets, farm visits, and a soak at one of the world's rare moor hot springs.

activities.title: Rokkatei Main Store
activities.description: Hokkaido's beloved confectionery. Try Marusei butter sandwich and fresh sakusaku pie from the in-store cafe.
details: 🎁 Fresh items are store-exclusive — stock up on omiyage

activities.title: Ryugetsu Sweetpia Garden
activities.description: Watch Sanporoku baumkuchen being made — layers of cake mimicking tree rings.

activities.title: Tokachi Hills Farm Restaurant
activities.description: Farm-to-table lunch in the Tokachi countryside — seasonal, local, and excellent.

activities.title: Tokachigawa Moor Onsen
activities.description: Rare moor onsen — water filtered through ancient plant deposits gives it amber color and silky skin-softening texture. One of only a few moor hot springs in the world.
details: ♨️ Daiichi Hotel or Tokachigawa Granvrio Hotel
🌿 The water feels like liquid silk

meals.name: Ryokan Kaiseki
meals.description: Multi-course dinner with Tokachi beef and dairy desserts

title: Toyokoro Coast & Pacific Shore
description: The fishing town famous for Jewel Ice, dramatic Pacific coastline, and ice age fossils.

activities.title: Tokachigawa to the Pacific
activities.description: Drive south through farmland to the ocean — about 1 hour.

activities.title: Harukominami Beach (Otsu Coast)
activities.description: Walk the famous coast where Jewel Ice forms each January. In autumn: dramatic driftwood, crashing waves, total solitude.

activities.title: Churui Naumann Elephant Museum
activities.description: Japan's most complete Naumann elephant fossils, discovered here. Full-size skeleton replica in a fishing village.

activities.title: Toyokoro Seafood Shokudo
activities.description: Local eatery near the port. Toyokoro shishamo and salmon are legendary.

meals.name: Toyokoro Seafood Shokudo
meals.description: Fresh shishamo, salmon, and local fish

activities.title: Evening in Obihiro
activities.description: Drive back (~1 hour). Nishi-2-jo area for izakayas and local craft beer.

title: Wine, Art Gardens & Cheese
description: Tokachi wine culture, birch forest art gardens, and artisan cheese in autumn gold.

activities.title: Ikeda Wine Castle
activities.description: European-style chateau on a hill. Free tastings of cold-climate Hokkaido wines with panoramic autumn farmland views.

activities.title: Rokkatei Art Village (Rokka no Mori)
activities.description: Forest garden with small galleries among birch groves. In October, the golden birch canopy is luminous and peaceful.
details: 🍂 Golden birch canopy in October — stunning

activities.title: Tokachi Cheese Tasting
activities.description: Visit an artisan cheese producer. Fresh mozzarella, aged cheeses, and the best soft-serve ice cream in Japan.

activities.title: Green Park & Dinner
activities.description: Stroll through Obihiro's large park for autumn color, then dinner.
details: 🍂 Tree-lined paths beautiful in early autumn

title: Lake Shikaribetsu & Nukabira Onsen
description: Hokkaido's highest lake and a hidden onsen town in blazing autumn forests.

activities.title: Drive to Lake Shikaribetsu
activities.description: North from Obihiro into the Daisetsuzan foothills. Autumn colors intensify with every kilometer of elevation.

activities.title: Lakeside Walk
activities.description: Hokkaido's highest lake (810m) in a volcanic caldera. Fiery autumn leaves on still water — one of Hokkaido's most stunning scenes. Home to the endemic Miyabe char, found nowhere else.
details: 🌡️ Noticeably cooler — bring a warm jacket

meals.name: Lakeside Cafe
meals.description: Warm udon with caldera lake views

activities.title: Nukabira Onsen Town
activities.description: A tiny hot spring town hidden in the mountains. Old wooden ryokan along a river, steam rising, almost no tourists. Secret Japan.
details: 🌉 Taushubetsu Bridge viewpoint nearby — a phantom bridge that appears and disappears
🍂 Surrounding birch forest ablaze in autumn

meals.name: Ryokan Kaiseki
meals.description: Grilled char, wild vegetables, venison in season

tips.text: 💡 Nukabira is Hokkaido's most underrated onsen town. Most tourists skip it entirely — that's exactly why it's special.

title: Daisetsuzan National Park
description: Japan's largest national park — towering gorge, twin waterfalls, and the earliest fall foliage in Japan.

activities.title: Nukabira to Sounkyo
activities.description: Through the heart of Daisetsuzan — 2 hours of birch, ash, and maple in full autumn color. Like driving through a painting.

activities.title: Gorge & Twin Waterfalls
activities.description: 100m columnar basalt cliffs. Ryusei Falls (Meteor) and Ginga Falls (Milky Way) — white water against red and gold foliage.
details: 🚶 Easy 20 min walk to the waterfalls

activities.title: Alpine Views by Gondola
activities.description: Ride above the canopy for sweeping Daisetsuzan views in full autumn color. A chairlift goes higher for alpine panoramas.
details: 🌡️ Much colder at the top — winter jacket required

meals.name: Sounkyo Restaurant
meals.description: Ramen or set meal at ropeway base

activities.title: Sounkyo Onsen Soak
activities.description: Soak while looking up at towering basalt cliffs and autumn trees. Completely surreal.
details: ♨️ Taisetsu Hotel or Sounkyo Kanko Hotel

title: Biei & Furano Rolling Hills
description: Patchwork hills, lone trees, Shirogane Blue Pond, and Furano wine country.

activities.title: Sounkyo to Biei
activities.description: South through Kamikawa to the rolling hills. About 90 minutes.

activities.title: Biei's Iconic Hills
activities.description: Drive past Ken & Mary Tree, Mild Seven Hill, Christmas Tree Hill. Golden harvested fields, lone trees on ridges, distant mountains.
details: 🚗 Best by car — stop every few minutes

activities.title: Blue Pond (青い池)
activities.description: Turquoise pond surrounded by dead birch trees. In autumn, blue water against red and gold foliage is stunning.

activities.title: Furano Winery & Cheese Factory
activities.description: Hilltop winery with valley views. Cheese Factory next door has fresh camembert, pizza, and ice cream.

activities.title: Drive South to Tokachi
activities.description: Back to Obihiro through autumn countryside, about 2 hours.
